plan.name: 10K in 45 min: 10-week plan
plan.description: 10 weeks, 4 runs a week, to run a 10K in 45 min (4:30/km). Written for a VMA around 15 km/h. Week 1 is about 30 km; the biggest week reaches 44 km and the longest run lasts 1h15. Every session has its targets: a share of VMA for easy runs and intervals, your goal pace for race-pace work.

cycles.name: Base
cycles.description: Easy volume, short fast reps and strides. The long run grows a little each week. Week 4 is lighter, to absorb the work.

sessions.name: Fartlek
sessions.description: 20 min warm-up, 8 × (1 min fast at 92–97% VMA / 1 min easy), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 40 min easy (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: Easy run + strides
sessions.description: 40 min easy (62–70% VMA), then 6 strides of 20 s: fast but relaxed, walk back between them.

sessions.name: Long run
sessions.description: 45 min at an easy, even pace (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: 30/30 intervals
sessions.description: 20 min warm-up, 14 × (30 s at 100–105% VMA / 30 s jog), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 45 min easy (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: Tempo run
sessions.description: 20 min warm-up, 20 min steady (80–84% VMA), 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Long run
sessions.description: 55 min at an easy, even pace (62–70% VMA).

cycles.name: Speed and 10K pace
cycles.description: VMA intervals and reps at 10K pace: the hardest block of the plan. Week 8 is lighter, to absorb the work.

sessions.name: VMA intervals
sessions.description: 20 min warm-up, 10 × 400 m at 100–105% VMA with 90 s jog between, 10 min cool-down.

sessions.name: Easy run
sessions.description: 45 min easy (62–70% VMA).

sessions.name: Long run

sessions.name: Tempo run

sessions.name: Long run, fast finish
sessions.description: 1h10 in all: easy (62–70% VMA), then the last 10 min at 80–84% VMA.

sessions.name: Race day: 10K
sessions.description: Race day. Settle at 10K pace (4:30/km) from the start and hold it; only speed up in the last kilometres if your legs say yes.
